name: Akeno Delusion
source:
Ryuutarou is a high school loner with a bad reputation. However, his mundane life changes when his classmate Akeno decides to befriend him, despite the negative rumors circulating around school. Whether her choice to get involved with him is good or bad, is up to destiny.

[From [url=https://lunariamv.tumblr.com/post/741000712887107584]the developer's blog[/url]]
